metadata.title: Quantitative chain extensions and integral cohomological fillings
metadata.abstract: We develop two methods in quantitative homological algebra: A declarative approach to integral cohomological filling problems and a quantitatively controlled replacement of normed chain complexes by their homology complex. Both methods are connected through so-called chain extensions. As applications, we obtain transparent proofs for uniform integral simplicial cohomological fillings for subdivisions of simplicial complexes, for uniform integral cohomological fillings of certain finite coverings, and for lower bounds of the $\ell^1$-semi-norm on product spaces.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 受控链延拓与整系数上同调填充
analysis.workSummary: 发展整系数上同调填充的 declarative 方法和以同调复形替代赋范链复形的定量方法，通过 chain extension 相连；应用于细分的一致填充、特定有限覆盖及乘积 ℓ¹ 半范数下界。
analysis.breakthrough: 把多个定量上同调估计组织为可重复使用的代数工具。
analysis.limitations: 有限覆盖应用限于指定类别；摘要未给出普遍适用的维数无关常数。
